articles.title: They Dreamed of Going Home to Iran. Then the Bombs Fell.
articles.excerpt: Iranian Americans who had planned to visit or return to their homeland now face an agonizing reality: a war with no clear end and family they cannot reach.
articles.image_caption: Iranian Americans who once planned to return home are now grappling with fear for family members caught in the crossfire of escalating military strikes.
articles.nri_angle: Iranian Americans who dreamed of returning to their homeland are now divided over whether the U.S. war with Iran will deliver the democratic change they sought or destroy the home they longed to return to.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Karnataka Council Chairman Basavaraj Horatti Resigns After 46-Year Legislative Career
articles.excerpt: The 80-year-old BJP leader and eight-time MLC steps down as Chairman of the Karnataka Legislative Council, ending one of Indian politics' longest legislative tenures.

articles.title: Supreme Court Orders DNA Tests, MEA Nodal Officer for Indians Killed in Russia-Ukraine War
articles.excerpt: The court directed the government to help families identify mortal remains, file compensation claims and communicate in vernacular languages, as the Centre disclosed that 51 of 219 Indians who joined Russian forces are dead or missing.
articles.nri_angle: India has 240,000 active seafarers, many from diaspora-connected families; the Supreme Court case and Black Sea attacks directly affect NRI communities with relatives in maritime service.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi Vows Campaign Against E20 Fuel as Consumer Backlash Intensifies
articles.excerpt: The Congress leader accused the government of 'stealing money and destroying lives' through mandatory ethanol blending, joining a growing chorus of opposition from transport unions, social media movements and automakers.
articles.image_caption: Rahul Gandhi has launched a national campaign against E20 ethanol-blended fuel, accusing the government of damaging consumers' vehicles.
articles.nri_angle: E20 fuel controversy affects NRI vehicle owners visiting India and highlights policy transparency concerns that mirror diaspora governance expectations.

articles.title: Kerala Reports 105 Chikungunya Cases as Monsoon Fuels Outbreak Fears
articles.excerpt: Health authorities have intensified mosquito control across four districts as confirmed cases rise during peak monsoon season — a warning for NRIs planning trips to Kerala.
articles.image_caption: Health officials in Kerala have reported 105 confirmed chikungunya cases, with the monsoon season creating conditions for rapid Aedes mosquito breeding across several districts.
articles.nri_angle: With Onam festival season approaching, NRIs planning trips to Kerala should be aware of the outbreak and consult healthcare providers about the two FDA-approved chikungunya vaccines before traveling.

articles.title: Modi Hosts Breakfast for New NDA Allies as Coalition Nears Supermajority
articles.excerpt: Prime Minister Modi welcomed 45 newly elected Rajya Sabha MPs, including rebel Trinamool Congress lawmakers who merged with NCPI, urging them to avoid 'Delhi intrigues' and focus on governance.
articles.nri_angle: The NDA's march toward a supermajority could enable constitutional changes — including delimitation and simultaneous elections — that reshape the democratic framework Indian Americans and NRIs follow closely.

articles.title: Kejriwal Slams India's New Social Media Law Requiring Takedowns Within Three Hours
articles.excerpt: The AAP leader accuses the Modi government of using tightened IT rules to silence critics, as police file a case against Meta's India head over Facebook videos targeting the PM.
articles.nri_angle: India's social media crackdown directly affects how the diaspora engages with Indian political discourse online, while the legal action against Meta's India head raises concerns about the regulatory environment for Indian-American tech executives.

articles.title: CBI Chargesheet Reveals How NTA Experts Leaked NEET Papers Using Chits and Memory
articles.excerpt: Thirteen people have been charged in the multi-state NEET-UG 2026 paper leak syndicate, with the CBI detailing how testing agency insiders memorized questions and smuggled them out on handwritten notes.
articles.image_caption: The CBI chargesheet details how NTA officials used chits and memorised answers to leak NEET-UG exam papers across multiple states.
articles.nri_angle: The NEET paper leak scandal affects thousands of Indian American families whose children prepare for the exam to pursue medical education in India, and raises questions about the integrity of India's standardized testing infrastructure.

articles.title: Supreme Court Dismisses 'Cheap Publicity' Plea Seeking Criminal Probe Against Justice Varma
articles.excerpt: The bench rejected the petition calling for an FIR and SIT investigation into the unaccounted cash controversy involving Delhi High Court's former judge Yashwant Varma.
articles.image_caption: The Supreme Court of India dismissed a petition seeking a criminal probe against Justice Varma, calling it 'cheap publicity' and an abuse of the judicial process.
articles.nri_angle: The case highlights questions about judicial accountability in India, a matter closely watched by the Indian diaspora invested in the country's institutional integrity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Assam Floods Kill 85 and Displace Over 700,000 in State's Worst Monsoon Crisis
articles.excerpt: A cloudburst in Nagaland triggered devastating flooding across Upper Assam's Brahmaputra Valley, submerging nearly 900 villages and destroying 37,000 hectares of cropland.
articles.image_caption: Floodwaters inundated villages across Upper Assam after heavy monsoon rainfall swelled the Brahmaputra and its tributaries beyond danger levels. Rescue operations evacuated thousands from submerged areas in Sivasagar and Charaideo districts.
articles.nri_angle: The floods have devastated communities in Assam with deep ties to the diaspora, prompting relief campaigns from Indian-Americans and raising questions about the pace of flood-control infrastructure investment in the Northeast.

articles.title: Americans Still Need $110,000 to Afford the Typical Home as Affordability Barely Budges
articles.excerpt: A new Redfin report finds the income required to buy the median U.S. home has stayed near record highs, leaving the typical household $22,000 short.
articles.nri_angle: Indian American households earn above the national median but are concentrated in the least affordable metros like San Francisco and San Jose, where housing costs often exceed even high tech salaries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: New Mexico Court Orders Meta to Pay $942 Million in Landmark Child Safety Ruling
articles.excerpt: A judge added $567 million in abatement costs on top of the earlier $375 million jury verdict, making it the largest child safety penalty against a social media company.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian American parents, the ruling underscores growing legal momentum to hold social media platforms accountable for child safety and could influence how their children use these platforms.

articles.excerpt: Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani grants interim injunction protecting Alakh Pandey's personality rights, directing Google, Meta, X, and Telegram to remove sexually explicit and impersonation content.

articles.title: Emerging Markets Learn a Painful Lesson as AI Tech Hype Unravels

articles.image_caption: Samsung Electronics, a bellwether for Asian tech markets, has seen its stock slide amid weakening AI chip demand and rising geopolitical uncertainty.
articles.nri_angle: India is emerging as an unlikely beneficiary of the AI selloff, with foreign investors rotating back into Indian equities after months of outflows, making the country's 'anti-AI' trade status a potential advantage for diaspora investors.

articles.title: How the Iran War Exposed China's New Oil Weapon: Clean Energy Dominance
